mainEntity.name: How much does a BMW Z4 M40i engine replacement cost in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: A BMW Z4 M40i engine replacement typically costs £3,500-£7,500 supply-only for rebuilt units, or £5,500-£10,500 fitted by a specialist. Used B58B30 engines: £2,500-£4,500 supply-only. Reconditioned units: £4,200-£6,500 supply-only. Rebuilt units with warranty: £5,500-£8,500 supply-only. Professional fitting adds £1,000-£2,000 depending on workshop location. LCI B58B30M2 units command premium pricing: £3,500-£5,500 used.

mainEntity.name: Is the BMW Z4 M40i B58 engine reliable?

acceptedAnswer.text: The B58 is widely regarded as one of BMW's most reliable modern turbo engines. However, it has known weaknesses that typically appear between 50,000-100,000 miles. PCV diaphragm failure integrated into valve cover - replace with upgraded unit. Electric water pump failure - replace preventatively at 60k miles. Charge pipe cracking on track cars - upgrade to aluminium. Regular oil changes with BMW LL-01 approved oil are essential. Many owners report 100,000+ miles with no major issues.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of PCV failure in a BMW Z4 M40i?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common symptoms are a whistling noise from the engine bay, excessive oil consumption (1L per 1,000 miles or more), rough idle, and visible oil leaks around the valve cover. Whistling noise that changes with engine RPM. Oil consumption increasing noticeably. Blue smoke on start-up. PCV failure can lead to oil seal failure if left unchecked. Specialist valve cover replacement costs £700-£1,200.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of water pump failure in a BMW Z4 M40i?

acceptedAnswer.text: The B58's electric water pump can fail suddenly with little warning. Overheating within a mile of failure. Coolant loss without visible external leaks. Warning lights on the dashboard. Electric water pump failure is more common than mechanical pump failure on B58 engines. Proactive replacement at 60k-70k miles is strongly recommended.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine on a high-mileage BMW Z4 M40i?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a Z4 M40i worth £30,000-£50,000, a rebuilt B58 at £5,500-£8,500 can make financial sense if the body, interior, and chassis are in good condition. Compare replacement cost against vehicle value - replacement is viable up to 70% of car's value. Low-mileage M40i examples command strong money (£30k-£40k). B58 is a robust engine - replacement restores factory performance. Always factor 12-month warranty into replacement decision.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between the Z4 M40i and the Z4 sDrive30i?

acceptedAnswer.text: The key differences between the Z4 M40i and sDrive30i are significant: M40i uses turbocharged B58B30, 340-382hp - performance flagship. sDrive30i uses naturally aspirated N52B30, 258hp - more economical. M40i replacement costs significantly more (£5,500-£8,500 vs £2,400-£3,800 for N52). M40i offers 0-62mph in 4.5 seconds vs 5.5+ seconds for 30i. M40i is the choice for performance enthusiasts.

historyTimeline.h2: BMW Z4 M40i - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The BMW Z4 M40i is the flagship performance variant of the G29 Z4, launched in 2019 as the spiritual successor to the Z4M. Powered exclusively by BMW's acclaimed B58B30 3.0-litre turbocharged straight-six, it delivers 340hp in standard form and up to 382hp in later LCI variants. The B58 - widely regarded as one of BMW's most reliable modern engines - combines closed-deck construction, integrated exhaust manifold, and TwinPower turbo technology for effortless performance.

milestones.description: G29 Z4 M40i launched with B58B30, 340hp, 500Nm, 8-speed automatic
B58B30M1 engine code introduced; power unchanged
Minor ECU updates for improved response
LCI facelift: B58B30M2 with 382hp, 6-speed manual option introduced
present - B58B30M2 continues with 382hp, 8-speed auto and 6-speed manual options

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the BMW Z4 M40i is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points specific to the B58 turbo straight-six.

commonProblems.h2: BMW Z4 M40i Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The BMW Z4 M40i's B58 turbo straight-six is widely regarded as one of BMW's most reliable modern engines, but it's not immune to wear. The most common issues - PCV diaphragm failure, water pump failure, and charge pipe fragility - are well-documented and typically occur between 50,000-80,000 miles. Every rebuilt engine supplied through EnginesMarket includes upgraded components designed to address these original failure points - plus a minimum 12-month unlimited mileage warranty.

problems.h4: PCV Diaphragm Failure - Why the BMW Z4 M40i Whistles and Burns Oil
problems.affectedModels: BMW Z4 M40i (G29 2019-present, B58B30, B58B30M1, B58B30M2)
problems.rootCause: The crankcase ventilation (PCV) system is integrated into the valve cover. The rubber diaphragm tears over time, causing excessive crankcase pressure, whistling noises, oil consumption, and oil leaks.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace complete valve cover with integrated PCV, new gaskets, breather hoses
repairOptions.longevity: Restores crankcase pressure control; 60,000+ mile lifespan

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit rebuilt B58 with upgraded valve cover and PCV components, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Required if oil consumption caused catalytic converter damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical BMW Z4 M40i is worth £30,000-£50,000 depending on age, mileage, and specification. Given the vehicle's premium value, engine replacement is generally viable even at the upper end of the cost range. For higher-mileage examples with other wear issues, evaluate the vehicle's overall condition before committing.
problems.recommendation: PCV failure on the B58 is a well-understood issue. Specialist valve cover replacement with an upgraded PCV unit costs under £1,200 and resolves the problem permanently. This is almost always the right first step - a full engine replacement is rarely necessary unless the engine has suffered catastrophic failure or exceeded 100,000 miles with multiple other issues.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt B58 engine prices for your BMW Z4 M40i

problems.h4: Electric Water Pump Failure - Why the BMW Z4 M40i Overheats
problems.affectedModels: BMW Z4 M40i (G29 2019-present, B58B30, B58B30M1, B58B30M2)
problems.rootCause: The B58's electric water pump can fail prematurely, leading to overheating and potential engine damage. Symptoms include coolant loss, rising temperature gauge, and warning lights.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace electric water pump, thermostat, coolant flush
Supply & fit rebuilt B58 with new water pump, thermostat, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Required if overheating caused head gasket or cylinder head damage

problems.recommendation: On any B58-powered Z4 M40i approaching 60,000 miles, proactive electric water pump replacement is the single best investment you can make. A £500-£800 specialist preventative replacement is far cheaper than a warped cylinder head or full engine replacement.
problems.cta: -> Get quotes for BMW Z4 M40i water pump replacement and rebuilt engines

problems.h4: Charge Pipe Cracking - Why the BMW Z4 M40i Loses Boost
problems.affectedModels: BMW Z4 M40i (G29 2019-present, B58B30, B58B30M1, B58B30M2)
problems.rootCause: The B58's factory charge pipe is made of plastic that can crack under boost pressure, especially during track use or spirited driving. Symptoms include loss of power, boost leaks, and potentially limp mode.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace with OEM plastic charge pipe
Replace with aluminium or reinforced aftermarket charge pipe
repairOptions.longevity: Permanent solution - eliminates boost leak risk

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit rebuilt B58 with upgraded charge pipe, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Only required if charge pipe failure caused turbo damage

problems.recommendation: On any Z4 M40i that sees track use or aggressive driving, an aftermarket aluminium charge pipe is a worthwhile upgrade. At £500-£800 fitted, it's cheap insurance against a boost leak that could strand you on track.
problems.cta: -> Compare BMW Z4 M40i charge pipe and engine replacement costs
